Free forever — optional gifts only

Salvation is not for sale. Every verse, plan, prayer tool, and study room on this porch is free forever. No paywall. No “Pro” unlock. No account required for the Word.

KJV-only. Privacy-first. Offline-first. If you choose to give, you are helping servers, free outreach packs, and teaching content for others—never buying access for yourself. You are already welcome here.

Stay with today’s verse Where support goes Give only if you want

If you want to help — only if you want

You do not have to give. Not a dollar. Not a month. The Word stays free either way. If something here helped you and you want to keep the porch open for the next person, you choose the amount. There is no suggested number and no right size.

$

Leave it blank and walk on. That is a complete visit.

How often

A memorial or a longer gift can use this same box. Whatever you type is the whole story. There is no suggested number.

Where Your Gift Goes

  • Cloudflare hosting, CDN, and security hardening so the site stays fast and private even on hard days.
  • Teaching content — new Plans, Bible study tracks, workbooks, pastor resources, and family tools written by hand (no AI, no filler).
  • Free outreach — printable packs to rural churches, hospitals, prisons, missionaries, and new believers who have nothing to give.
  • Ministry operations — the builder’s time, disclosed honestly. “The labourer is worthy of his reward.” — 1 Timothy 5:18.
  • Long-term endowment toward a small, faithful team that can sustain and expand the work one day.

Three quiet ways to help today

Pray

Pray that the site remains useful, clean, and faithful for every person who opens it in pain, fear, grief, or exhaustion.

Share

If this porch has helped you, quietly share the homepage, a daily verse, or a Battle Plan with one person who needs it.

Return tomorrow

Come back for the next verse, the next plan, the next quiet moment with Scripture. Your presence here is already a gift.
